occupations.cat: Chief executives, senior officials and legislators

n.story:
Your role is being supercharged by an 'intelligence layer' that allows you to represent your members with unprecedented data-backed authority. Previously, a significant portion of your week was consumed by tracking legislative updates, managing member databases, and drafting policy briefs. AI now automates the 'monitoring' phase of your work, providing real-time alerts on political shifts and sentiment changes across thousands of sources, and drafting initial policy comparisons in seconds.

This shift allows you to reclaim your time for the fundamentally human aspects of your job: persuasion, diplomacy, and relationship building. When you walk into a meeting with government agencies or the board of directors, you aren't just bringing opinions; you're bringing AI-synthesized impact simulations that prove your group's position. You have moved from being a reactive advocate to a proactive strategist, using AI to identify emerging issues before they become crises, while your personal charisma and ethical judgment remain the deciding factors in every negotiation.

n.adv: Invest in developing your emotional intelligence and public speaking skills, as these will become your primary differentiators as AI handles the research and drafting.
